  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Reproducible Monte Carlo studies}

  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Monte Carlo seeds are derived from the master seed, model identity, and
replication index. They do not depend on dispatch order.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(DSEMr)
model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time")
study <- dsem_monte_carlo(
  model,
  replications = 100,
  generator = function(seed) simulate_dsem(n = 150, ar = 0.6, seed = seed),
  seed = 2026,
  truth = c("(Intercept)" = 0, lag1_y = 0.6, sigma2 = 1)
)
study$summary
```

The call is not evaluated while building the vignette because a defensible
simulation study should be run as a separate, archived analysis with adequate
iterations and computing resources.
